msg: Title says "EC declaration of conformity". RED Annex VI calls it the EU declaration of conformity; market surveillance reads the title first.
Cites the repealed R&TTE Directive 1999/5/EC. Radio equipment placed on the EU market is covered by Directive 2014/53/EU (RED).
No reference to Directive 2014/53/EU. Annex VI point 5 needs the Union harmonisation legislation the object conforms to.
No reference to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/30, the act that switched on the RED cybersecurity essential requirements.
Article 3(3)(d) (network protection) is not named. It applies to internet-connected radio equipment under (EU) 2022/30.
Article 3(3)(e) (personal data and privacy) is not named. State that it applies, or state why the equipment does not process personal data.
Article 3(3)(f) (protection from fraud) is not named. State that it applies, or state why the equipment does not transfer money or virtual currency.
Uses the withdrawn 1 August 2024 date. Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2444 moved the application of (EU) 2022/30 to 1 August 2025.
EN 18031 is cited without its 2024 edition. Annex VI point 6 wants the dated reference, e.g. EN 18031-1:2024.
EN 18031-1/-2/-3 are cited in the Official Journal with restrictions, so the presumption of conformity is not complete. Record the restriction here.
EN 18031 is cited but no notified body (name + four-digit number) and no statement that the restricted parts do not apply to this product.
Annex VI point 3 sentence is missing: this declaration of conformity is issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer.
Annex VI points 1 and 4 need a traceable identifier of the object: product model, type, batch or serial number.
Annex VI point 2 needs the name and the postal address of the manufacturer (or the authorised representative).
No firmware or software version. Cybersecurity conformity is version-bound, and Annex VI point 8 covers the software the equipment ships with.

need: signed for and on behalf of|place and date of issue
msg: Annex VI point 9 is missing: signed for and on behalf of, place and date of issue, name, function, signature.
The declaration is dated before 1 August 2025, when the cybersecurity requirements began to apply. It cannot cover (EU) 2022/30 as written.
The declaration is more than 12 months old. Re-confirm that every standard it cites is still cited in the Official Journal.
